001package bank.service;
002
003import bank.model.Account;
004import bank.model.Customer;
005import bank.model.Transaction;
006import bank.model.TransactionType;
007import bank.persistence.DataRepository;
008
009import java.math.BigDecimal;
010
011/**
012 * ============================================================================
013 *  TransactionService.java
014 *  Owner: Max Pribac (mpribac@umbc.edu)
015 * ============================================================================
016 *
017 *  ROLE:
018 *      Three public methods: deposit, withdraw, transfer. Each one:
019 *          1. Validates the input.
020 *          2. Calls the right method on the Account (credit / debit).
021 *          3. Records a Transaction on the Customer.
022 *          4. Tells the repository to save.
023 *
024 *  THE GOLDEN RULE:
025 *      Either the operation FULLY succeeds, or NOTHING changes. For a transfer
026 *      this means: if the credit to "to" fails after the debit to "from"
027 *      succeeded, the money must be put back on "from" before the error
028 *      propagates out.
029 * ============================================================================
030 */
031public class TransactionService {
032
033    private final DataRepository repository;
034    private final OverdraftPolicy overdraftPolicy;
035
036    public TransactionService(DataRepository repository, OverdraftPolicy overdraftPolicy) {
037        this.repository = repository;
038        this.overdraftPolicy = overdraftPolicy;
039    }
040
041    // ── DEPOSIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
042
043    /**
044     * Adds money to one of the customer's accounts.
045     *
046     * @param customer  the account owner
047     * @param accountId the target account
048     * @param amount    must be positive
049     */
050    public void deposit(Customer customer, String accountId, BigDecimal amount) {
051        requirePositive(amount);
052        Account account = customer.findAccount(accountId);
053        requireAccount(account, accountId);
054
055        account.credit(amount);
056        customer.recordTransaction(new Transaction(
057                TransactionType.DEPOSIT, accountId, amount, "Cash deposit"));
058        repository.save();
059    }
060
061    // ── WITHDRAW ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
062
063    /**
064     * Removes money from one of the customer's accounts.
065     * If the withdrawal would push the balance negative, the overdraft policy
066     * decides whether to allow it (and whether to charge a fee).
067     *
068     * @throws IllegalStateException if the withdrawal is not allowed
069     */
070    public void withdraw(Customer customer, String accountId, BigDecimal amount) {
071        requirePositive(amount);
072        Account account = customer.findAccount(accountId);
073        requireAccount(account, accountId);
074
075        if (!overdraftPolicy.canWithdraw(account, amount)) {
076            throw new IllegalStateException(
077                    "Withdrawal denied: would exceed overdraft limit on " + accountId);
078        }
079
080        BigDecimal fee = overdraftPolicy.overdraftFeeFor(account, amount);
081
082        account.debit(amount);
083        customer.recordTransaction(new Transaction(
084                TransactionType.WITHDRAW, accountId, amount, "Cash withdrawal"));
085
086        if (fee.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0) {
087            account.debit(fee);
088            customer.recordTransaction(new Transaction(
089                    TransactionType.FEE, accountId, fee, "Overdraft fee"));
090        }
091
092        repository.save();
093    }
094
095    // ── TRANSFER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
096
097    /**
098     * Moves money from one of the customer's accounts to another.
099     * Atomic: if the credit fails, the debit is rolled back.
100     */
101    public void transfer(Customer customer, String fromAccountId, String toAccountId, BigDecimal amount) {
102        requirePositive(amount);
103        if (fromAccountId.equals(toAccountId)) {
104            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot transfer to the same account.");
105        }
106
107        Account from = customer.findAccount(fromAccountId);
108        Account to   = customer.findAccount(toAccountId);
109        requireAccount(from, fromAccountId);
110        requireAccount(to,   toAccountId);
111
112        if (!overdraftPolicy.canWithdraw(from, amount)) {
113            throw new IllegalStateException(
114                    "Transfer denied: would exceed overdraft limit on " + fromAccountId);
115        }
116
117        from.debit(amount);
118        try {
119            to.credit(amount);
120        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
121            // Rollback the debit so the customer keeps their money.
122            from.credit(amount);
123            throw ex;
124        }
125
126        customer.recordTransaction(new Transaction(
127                TransactionType.TRANSFER_OUT, fromAccountId, amount,
128                "Transfer to " + toAccountId, toAccountId));
129        customer.recordTransaction(new Transaction(
130                TransactionType.TRANSFER_IN, toAccountId, amount,
131                "Transfer from " + fromAccountId, fromAccountId));
132
133        repository.save();
134    }
135
136    // ── Tiny helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
137
138    private static void requirePositive(BigDecimal amount) {
139        if (amount == null || amount.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0) {
140            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero.");
141        }
142    }
143
144    private static void requireAccount(Account account, String id) {
145        if (account == null) {
146            throw new IllegalArgumentException("No such account: " + id);
147        }
148    }
149}
